headline: HISTORIC BUNKER HILL MINE SHIPS FIRST CONCENTRATE — IDAHO SILVER VALLEY BACK IN PRODUCTION AFTER SIX YEARS OF REDEVELOPMENT
snippet: Bunker Hill Mining Corp. (TSX:BNKR | OTCQB:BHLL) announced on June 29, 2026 that its rebuilt 1,800 tpd processing facility in Kellogg, Idaho is producing concentrate for sale — marking the first silver-lead-zinc output from one of the most famous mines in U.S. history since its environmental shutdown. The company has more than 20,000 tonnes of ore stockpiled at the crusher and plans to ramp toward steady-state production of approximately nine concentrate trucks per day to Teck Resources' Trail smelter in British Columbia, 210 km north.

headline: KODIAK DOUBLES MPD PROGRAM TO 16,500M WITH SECOND RIG — COPPER JUNIOR EXPANDS AS SECTION 232 TARIFF DEADLINE HITS TOMORROW (TSXV:KDK)
snippet: Kodiak Copper Corp. (TSXV:KDK) announced June 29, 2026 that its 2026 exploration program at the MPD copper-gold porphyry project in southern British Columbia has been expanded from 6,500 metres to 16,500 metres with the addition of a second drill rig — accelerating work to grow the initial Mineral Resource Estimate across all seven deposits, which remain open in multiple directions. The timing is notable: with the U.S. Commerce Secretary submitting a report to President Trump by June 30, 2026 on whether to impose a phased 15%-then-30% duty on imported refined copper, North American copper producers and advanced explorers with domestic supply profiles are attracting capital ahead of a decision that could materially improve their relative economics.

headline: TRUMP COPPER CLOCK EXPIRES TOMORROW — COMMERCE SECRETARY REPORTS TO WHITE HOUSE ON 15% THEN 30% REFINED COPPER PHASED TARIFF DECISION
snippet: The June 1, 2026 White House proclamation establishing the current Section 232 copper tariff framework requires the Commerce Secretary to report to President Trump by June 30, 2026 on U.S. copper refining capacity and market conditions — after which Trump may impose a phased 15% duty on refined copper imports starting January 1, 2027 and 30% starting January 1, 2028. Already in effect: 50% tariffs on semi-finished copper products (pipes, rods, wire, sheets) since August 2025 and a 25% tariff on copper and most derivative products under the current regime. Analysts at Jefferies have identified Freeport-McMoRan, Rio Tinto, Hudbay Minerals, and Ivanhoe Electric as the primary beneficiaries of the existing tariff structure among producers with meaningful U.S. operational exposure; a positive commerce report tomorrow would extend that tailwind to domestic copper explorers and expand the M&A logic for U.S.-jurisdiction copper projects.

headline: ATSUTLA GETS ITS FIRST DRILL — TRAILBREAKER TARGETS 630 G/T AU QUARTZ VEINS ACROSS A 26KM DISTRICT IN NORTHWEST BRITISH COLUMBIA (TSXV:TBK)
snippet: Trailbreaker Resources Ltd. (TSXV:TBK) commenced its maiden 1,500–2,500-metre diamond drill program at the 100%-owned, 300 km² Atsutla Gold Project in northwest British Columbia on June 29, 2026, targeting the Highlands zone where surface quartz veins containing coarse visible gold have assayed up to 630 g/t Au and 1,894 g/t Ag across a 2.0 km by 1.5 km area. Upon completing the Highlands holes, the company will pivot to the Swan zone — a copper-gold-silver porphyry target 26 km to the east — marking the first systematic drilling across a property with five mineralized zones distributed over 26 kilometres of strike.

headline: 63 G/T GOLD IN A FOUR-VEIN ARRAY IN SANTA CRUZ — DAURA-FUNDED LA FLORA BUILDING Q3 DRILL CASE IN ARGENTINA (TSXV:LMS / OTCQB:LMSQF)
snippet: Latin Metals Inc. (TSXV:LMS | OTCQB:LMSQF) reported June 29, 2026 that partner-funded surface sampling at the La Flora Project in Santa Cruz Province, Argentina returned assays up to 63.88 g/t gold and 175.34 g/t silver, with results defining a four-vein, 100-metre-wide array over 380 metres within a ~1 kilometre vein system. Daura Gold Corp. (TSXV:DGC) is funding the Phase II drill program under deal terms that include US$1.7 million in payments to Latin Metals, 28,000 metres of drilling, and a NI 43-101 resource estimate — with Daura able to earn up to 80% interest — placing the La Flora discovery firmly in the partner-funded, no-dilution-to-optionee category that retail-friendly junior structures tend to generate on assay releases.

headline: NEW GOLD ZONE FOUND 2KM FROM HISTORICAL TREND IN ONTARIO'S MATACHEWAN CAMP — VAL-D'OR EXPANDS UNKNOWN FOOTPRINT AT BADEN PROSPECT (TSXV:VZZ)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Val-D'Or Mining Corp. (TSXV:VZZ)
snippet: Val-D'Or Mining Corporation (TSXV:VZZ) announced June 29, 2026 that drill hole BA-25-006 at the Baden Prospect, approximately 15 km northwest of Matachewan, Ontario, identified a previously unrecognized mineralized zone approximately 2 kilometres west of the main historical V2-Arbade Shaft trend — gold mineralisation associated with quartz-ankerite-calcite veins hosted in Syenite, with additional intervals up to 1.15 g/t Au over 1.5 m. The Phase I program drilled 3,735 metres in nine NQ holes across this helicopter-accessible Ontario property, and the 2-km lateral discovery gap between the new zone and the known trend suggests the Baden mineralized system is substantially wider than historical interpretation indicated.

headline: HAT PROJECT ADVANCING TO PRE-FEASIBILITY — DOUBLEVIEW'S C$7.27B NPV COPPER-COBALT-SCANDIUM ASSET TARGETS EARLY-2027 MRE UPDATE (TSXV:DBG)
source_name: Investing News Network / Doubleview Gold Corp. (TSXV:DBG)
snippet: Doubleview Gold Corp. (TSXV:DBG) announced June 29, 2026 that the Hat polymetallic project in northwestern British Columbia is advancing through an integrated drilling and technical program designed to deliver an updated Mineral Resource Estimate in early 2027 and support Pre-Feasibility Study planning — following June 9 drill results that extended gold-copper mineralisation approximately 150 metres east into a new Far East Zone, including 4.04 g/t Au over 8.0 metres. The company's clarified PEA shows a Scenario B NPV of C$7.27 billion at steady-state production of 74 kt copper, 254 koz gold, 376 koz silver, and 2.7 kt cobalt annually for the first 10 years — a copper-cobalt-scandium profile in a Canadian jurisdiction that positions Hat as a potential critical-minerals supply asset if the Section 232 copper tariff regime expands to refined copper in 2027.

headline: ACLARA HITS 99% PURITY RARE EARTH CARBONATE — SPREC PROCESS SIMPLIFIES DOWNSTREAM SEPARATION FOR BRAZIL AND CHILE PROJECTS (TSX:ARA)
source_name: Investing News Network / Aclara Resources Inc. (TSX:ARA)
snippet: Aclara Resources Inc. (TSX:ARA) announced June 29, 2026 the development of Super Pure Rare Earth Carbonate (SPREC) — a product containing approximately 99% rare earths content produced through the company's Santiago pilot plant, representing a significant advance over conventional Mixed Rare Earth Carbonate (MREC). By applying solvent extraction know-how from Aclara's U.S. downstream separation platform upstream within its proprietary Circular Mineral Harvesting (CMH) process, SPREC substantially reduces the impurity load entering the separation plant — the primary source of operational complexity and cost in rare earth refining — and is intended for deployment at the Carina Project in Brazil and the Penco Module in Chile, both of which are targeting production into what analysts now call the Western ex-China rare earth supply deficit.

headline: RISK/REWARD FLIPPED FOR PRECIOUS METALS — CONTRARIAN SETUP MIRRORS PRIOR CYCLE LOWS AS SPEC LONGS HIT DECADE COMPRESSION (GOLDSEEK)
snippet: A June 26, 2026 analysis on GoldSeek argues that the risk/reward for precious metals has flipped from the extreme negative setup that entered the year to a clearly positive one — mirroring the configuration that preceded the sharpest gold and silver recoveries of 2019, 2022, and early 2024 — as SPX/Gold ratio relief has cleared the technical pressure that made the early-2026 trade structurally dangerous. With speculative net longs in gold and silver compressed to decade lows on the Commitment of Traders report, and the same positioning extreme that historically preceded the most violent precious metals recoveries now in place, the analytical case for adding quality precious metals positions at current levels is the mirror image of the case that justified reducing exposure entering the year.
